invented_facts: The 128 GB configuration 'matched and exceeded competitor speeds on those same models': the paper does not report its 8B result.
'Unquantified local AI workloads' drained the battery in about 2 hours 40 minutes: that result is specifically for continuous local language-model inference.
The 32 GB configuration was 'throttled' to 6 tokens per second: the paper attributes that result to the model not fitting entirely in fast memory and falling back to slower paths.
'Competitors with larger, faster GPUs dominate this workload' generalizes a finding about one tested competitor.
notes: The length and three-bullet format are correct, but the summary omits many required test conditions and caveats, including the three-unit sample, single competitor configuration, 4-bit quantization and untested output quality, and the video-playback conditions behind the battery rating. It also omits the AI-assisted design result.
